Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api

Class VoiceCategory

java.lang.Object
net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.VoiceCategory
public final class VoiceCategory extends Object
Audio categories carried with every voice frame. The category tells the client how to play it: PROXIMITY is attenuated by distance and panned; the other player categories play "in the head" at full volume (times the frame gain).

Use these values in VoiceRouteHook.Sink.send(java.util.UUID, byte, float), in VoiceTarget and when reading ClientReceiveAudioEvent.getCategory(). Categories 4..15 are free for addons and play like GLOBAL.

Since:
1.1.0
